subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw split this umbrella into native tool batching, context block lifecycle, and plan enforcement tracks, or reject/narrow any of those tracks under the current core/plugin roadmap?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, persisted context semantics, config settings, and runner enforcement policy; repository policy treats those as product-sensitive core decisions rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Narrower Issues
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45503 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66672 canonical for their portions and open a separate batch-tools issue if maintainers want that work tracked independently.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Close or narrow the umbrella if maintainers decide the plan-enforcement and context-block semantics are too much heavy orchestration for core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available adjacent history across planning, web search, and context pruning, making him the best routing owner for the product split.
